item.title: Mouse VS AI
item.description: Paper Summary: What the Paper Is Trying to Do The paper introduces the Mouse vs. AI: Robust Foraging Competition, a benchmark designed to jointly evaluate visual robustness and neural alignment in artificial agents using a shared active sensorimotor task. 1. Goal & Core Problem Standard reinforcement learning and computer vision models are notoriously brittle to real-world visual variations (such as fog or occlusion), whereas biological systems like mice easily maintain stable performance under degraded visual inputs.
